newsitem.title: USA: Atlanta proposes 42 percent sewer rate hike -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Atlanta proposes 42 percent sewer rate hike -- paper.

text.p: Atlanta has proposed raising residential sewer rates by 42 percent over four years to fund pollution control efforts, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported.
The plan would raise $45 million to fund improvments to reduce the city's pollution of the Chattahoochee River and to cover $7.2 million in state fines.
Atlanta pays fines of $20,000 a day to the state for failing to meet a state deadline to build treatment facilities to keep raw sewage from flowing into the river during heavy rains.
The proposed rate hike was scheduled to go before the City Council in February. If approved then, customers would see a 10 percent increase in their bills beginning in May.
